subject: Botany
question_text:
Match List I with List II:

| List I (Bioactive molecules) | List II (Importance) |
| :--- | :--- |
| A. Streptokinase | II. Removal of clots from the blood vessels |
| B. Statins | III. Blood cholesterol-lowering agent |
| C. Lipases | IV. Detergent formulations |
| D. Cyclosporin A | I. Immunosuppressive agent |

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:
explanation:
• **Streptokinase** (produced by *Streptococcus*): Used as a 'clot buster' for removing clots from blood vessels of patients suffering myocardial infarction (A-II).
• **Statins** (produced by *Monascus purpureus*): Blood cholesterol-lowering agent (B-III).
• **Lipases**: Used in detergent formulations to remove oily stains (C-IV).
• **Cyclosporin A** (produced by *Trichoderma polysporum*): Immunosuppressive agent in organ transplantation (D-I).
Hence, the correct match is **A-II, B-III, C-IV, D-I**.
